sentences.text_target: Tom puts his laptop on the table.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm pʊts hɪz ˈlæptɒp ɒn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
sentences.text_native: Tom pose son ordinateur portable sur la table.

sentences.text_target: He wants to turn on the screen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɒnts tu tɜːn ɒn ðə skriːn/

sentences.text_target: A blue light shows the battery is low.
sentences.phonetic: /ə bluː laɪt ʃəʊz ðə ˈbætəri ɪz ləʊ/
sentences.text_native: Une voyant bleu indique que la batterie est faible.

sentences.text_target: He takes a cable.
Tom plugs the cable into the wall.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm plʌɡz ðə ˈkeɪbəl ˈɪntuː ðə wɔːl/
sentences.text_native: Tom branche le câble dans la prise murale.

sentences.text_target: The power goes into the computer.
He presses the power button.
sentences.text_native: Il appuie sur le bouton d'alimentation.

sentences.text_target: The device begins to start.
He waits for the desktop.
A nice picture appears.
Tom sees a small icon.
He takes the mouse in his hand.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks ðə maʊs ɪn hɪz hænd/
sentences.text_native: Il prend la souris en main.

sentences.text_target: He moves the mouse to click the icon.
sentences.phonetic: /hi muːvz ðə maʊs tu klɪk ði ˈaɪkɒn/
sentences.text_native: Il déplace la souris pour cliquer sur l'icône.

sentences.text_target: The web browser opens.
He wants to use the internet.
The wifi connects to the local network.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ kəˈnekts tu ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈnetwɜːk/
sentences.text_native: Le wifi se connecte au réseau local.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks at the search bar.
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde la barre de recherche.

sentences.text_target: He uses the keyboard.
He types every letter carefully.
sentences.text_native: Il tape chaque lettre avec soin.

sentences.text_target: He writes his own name.
Some data appears on the screen.
He opens a new folder.
Tom creates a text document.
He writes a short message inside.
sentences.text_native: Il y écrit un court message.

sentences.text_target: He types a secret password for safety.
sentences.phonetic: /hi taɪps ə ˈsiːkrɪt ˈpɑːswɜːd fɔːr ˈseɪfti/
sentences.text_native: Il tape un mot de passe secret par sécurité.

sentences.text_target: He wants to save the file.
The system saves the work fast.
sentences.text_native: Le système sauvegarde le travail rapidement.

sentences.text_target: Tom closes the document window.
sentences.text_native: Tom ferme la fenêtre du document.

sentences.text_target: He decides to shut down the laptop.
sentences.phonetic: /hi dɪˈsaɪdz tu ʃʌt daʊn ðə ˈlæptɒp/

sentences.text_target: The screen goes dark and he is done.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə skriːn ɡəʊz dɑːk ænd hi ɪz dʌn/
sentences.text_native: L'écran devient noir et il a terminé.
